import importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("generators/56f043832ecb/workspace/parametric/audit.py")
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("audit_gap",p)
a=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(a)
before=a.source_snapshot()
n=a._load_native()
rows=[]
with a._local_imports(a.RUNTIME,a.HOME):
 execute,identity,bridge=a._real_evaluator(a.RUNTIME)
 cached=a.MemoizedEvaluator(execute)
 try:
  for seed in (0,17):
   for setting in n.SETTINGS:
    claim=n.generate(seed,setting,3,4)
    episode=dict(seed=seed,settings=setting,program=claim["program_solution"],train=[],test=[])
    for split in ("train","test"):
     for pair in claim[split]:
      output=cached(episode["program"],pair["input"])
      if output!=pair["output"]:
       raise ValueError("Gold claim differs from protected Racket")
      episode[split].append(dict(input=pair["input"],output=output))
    rival=next(r for r in a.make_rivals(n,setting) if r["name"]=="rectangle_only")
    checked=a.audit_rivals(episode,[rival],cached)
    rows.append(dict(episode=episode,audit=checked))
 finally:
  bridge.close()
after=a.source_snapshot()
out=Path("../checks/56f043832ecb/rectangle-gap-r1.json")
report=dict(schema="56f043832ecb-rectangle-gap-v1",racket=identity,source_snapshot_before=before,source_snapshot_after=after,sources_unchanged=before==after,cases=rows,unique_racket_executions=len(cached.results),executions=list(cached.results.values()))
out.write_bytes(a._bytes(report))
print(json.dumps(dict(report=str(out),sources_unchanged=before==after,unique_racket_executions=len(cached.results),cases=[dict(seed=r["episode"]["seed"],settings=r["episode"]["settings"],status=r["audit"]["rivals"][0]["status"],first_refuting_demo=r["audit"]["rivals"][0]["first_refuting_demo"],first_disagreeing_query=r["audit"]["rivals"][0]["first_disagreeing_query"]) for r in rows])))
